description: Experimental TF3 multiplayer prototype. Probe v33 / bridge v12: prepared sessions verify game, multiplayer package, installed mods and source save before exchanging actions. Detailed world digests detect persistent content differences. v33 syncs loans through the game's loan script, orders replays of both PCs, compares vehicle positions, cargo and towns, and probes holding builds for common-tick execution.
name: Multiplayer Probe (dev)
summary: Logs the TF3 Lua sandbox and engine API for multiplayer research.
